pull_request.title: Tracker: select 2 mm strixels with reconstruction and service studies
pull_request.head: codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study
pull_request.body:
## Findings

Compare 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2 mm strixel local-v lengths at fixed 75 µm fine pitch on the maintained tracker. **Human reviewer asalzburger-review selected 2 mm as the new working baseline and approved the study on 2026-11-02.** The combined tracker now exports 75 µm × 2 mm barrel/endcap strixel readouts. The [selection and current-baseline recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/baseline-selection.md) records the decision, 380,436,480 strixel channels (75% fewer), and response qualifications.

The assembly records both original/selected segmentation and source hashes. Sensor placements, material and physical service allocations remain unchanged. A new pure JSON preparation step scales only strixel local-v Gaussian sigma by four, conditional on verified native-ID remapping of explicitly identified 0.5 mm reference widths. This extrapolation is not a calibrated 2 mm response; frozen historical reconstruction runners and evidence retain their original guards.

- Strixel channel counts fall by **50%, 66.7% and 75%** at 1, 1.5 and 2 mm. Cable/power estimates are conditional accounting scenarios; no physical service redesign or material reduction is simulated.
- The single-particle GBTS cross-check covers **80 × 1,000 native case-events**, five particle/transport populations and four pT values. At 2 mm, the central 100 GeV muon z0 core is **10.6% wider in Fatras and 15.1% wider in Geant4** than at 0.5 mm on the same common matched events.
- Fatras ttbar + exactly 200 pileup interactions uses **100 shared physical events reconstructed at each length**. After ambiguity resolution and guide-like analysis cuts:

| Strixel length | Hard-scatter efficiency [%] | Pileup efficiency [%] | Fake fraction [%] | Fake fraction, frozen quality only [%] |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0.5 mm | 80.36 | 75.81 | 0.195 | 3.46 |
| 1 mm | 80.40 | 75.86 | 0.181 | 3.65 |
| 1.5 mm | 80.40 | 75.90 | 0.204 | 3.94 |
| 2 mm | 80.36 | 75.91 | 0.230 | 4.24 |

For 2 mm minus 0.5 mm, the guide-selected hard-scatter efficiency change is **0.000 percentage points [−0.211, +0.202]**, and the fake-fraction change is **+0.034 [+0.005, +0.064] percentage points**, with paired pointwise 95% event-bootstrap intervals. Equal aggregate efficiency does not establish equivalence.

![ttbar efficiency and candidate composition](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/ttbar-pu200/figures/guide-overview.png)

Reports: [truth tracking and service estimates](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/results.md), [single-particle GBTS](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/gbts/summary.md), [ttbar + pileup](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/ttbar-pu200/README.md). Reports link the complete figure sets, definitions, uncertainty intervals and independent assessments.

## Included artifacts and reproduction

Includes **78 PNG/PDF exports**, concise reports/provenance, and the generation, reconstruction, audit, statistics and plotting scripts with tests. The recipes document environments, source/configuration/input hashes, seeds and exact commands:

- [Truth-associated pitch/service workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/software/analysis/strixel_pitch_study/README.md)
- [Single-particle GBTS workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/software/analysis/strixel_reconstruction/README.md)
- [Fatras ttbar + pileup workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/software/analysis/strixel_ttbar/README.md)

**No event-level run files, ROOT outputs, NPZ arrays, compressed case datasets or caches are added to the PR.** All 674 excluded study files remain local and ignored, with hashes in the compact artifact inventory. Large unpublished payload commits were removed from the history to be pushed; original local snapshots remain archived for provenance. The published tree retains the pinned native-validator history. Plots and scientific source contents are unchanged by that cleanup.

Task-owned Pythia/Fatras/GBTS components provide the missing runtime binding and numerically safe evaluation needed for the repeatable chain. Numerical corrections preserve selected observables/random draws and are backed by native controls and byte-identical particle/hit/reconstruction replay; they remain isolated from shared dependencies and production geometry.

## Validation and interpretation

The [human selection](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/109#issuecomment-6573426341) and [approval](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/109#pullrequestreview-5734614248) apply to study head `07b38a7`. The subsequent baseline integration has a separate independent PhysVal assessment at `268f7a1` plus CMake amendment `88a77da`: all 27 component export files and materials are byte-identical; combined XML differs only in coarse pitch and offset for the two strixel readouts. No fresh native geometry or reconstruction execution is claimed by this source-level comparison. DES042 remains DRAFT under the engineering lifecycle.

- **8 current assembly/integration tests, 3 selected-response tests and 33 session/documentation-link tests pass.** The CI failure was a link to the intentionally excluded local `profiles.json.gz`; both report and generator now explain regeneration without requiring that payload. Historical DES040 fingerprints remain checked against unchanged evidence, with the three intentionally amended sources read at the pre-selection revision.

- **144 Python tests** and all **78 figure hashes/source bindings** pass. A separate clean checkout containing no DES-042 datasets passes the same tests and project/session/usage/workflow checks.
- All 400 ttbar reconstruction payloads and all 100 Fatras sample payloads match the preserved originals byte-for-byte. Full portable replay and 2,000 paired event-bootstrap calculations pass locally. Independent PhysVal assessment reproduced all 1,864 metrics/intervals and 10,920 representative count checks with no unresolved blocker.
- CI checks synthetic analysis tests and published figure integrity. Full native/event/statistical replay explicitly requires the local retained data or a regenerated campaign; it is not claimed as a data-free CI check.

Qualifications: constant 3 T and fixed geometry/material; the GBTS/ttbar scans use uncalibrated Gaussian local-v response without cluster merging. Boundary retries also change non-target smearing. The unchanged 2,000,000-edge GBTS cap is reached in **99/100 ttbar events**. The ttbar hard process follows the guide's **qqbar-only** setup. Six low-momentum Fatras step-limit losses remain documented; none is headline-eligible. These are qualified prototype results, without physical coarse-cell occupancy calibration, hardware-service qualification or formal detector-design acceptance.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Recorded the human 2 mm working-baseline selection, distinct scientific task `TASK-TRACK-STRIXEL-BASELINE`, exact-revision review and links from both layout pages. Physical bounds/material are invariant, so no R–Z regeneration is needed.
- [x] Recovered and reconciled **48 completed turns / 2,216 requests: 386,025,703 observed input+output tokens**, with canonical task ownership and per-day work labels. Cached/reasoning counters are subsets; active coordinator turn, unknown models/client version and other-device gaps remain excluded/explicit.
- [x] Plots and reproduction recipes retained; large reference-run payloads excluded from the PR tree and newly pushed data-bearing history.
- [x] Actual human working-baseline selection and technical approval are recorded; formal engineering lifecycle and service/response qualification remain separate.
- [x] Refreshed `interactions/pr-0109.json` with public comment/approval, eight canonical session links, 48 allowlisted completed-turn snapshots, verified specialist identities, tool provenance and unique token-account references.
- [ ] Merge after current-head CI and GitHub review gates; this preparation does not merge the PR.

## Findings

Compare 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2 mm strixel local-v lengths at fixed 75 µm fine pitch on the maintained tracker. **Human reviewer asalzburger-review selected 2 mm as the new working baseline and approved the study on 2026-11-02.** The combined tracker now exports 75 µm × 2 mm barrel/endcap strixel readouts. The [selection and current-baseline recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/baseline-selection.md) records the decision, 380,436,480 strixel channels (75% fewer), and response qualifications.

The assembly records both original/selected segmentation and source hashes. Sensor placements, material and physical service allocations remain unchanged. A new pure JSON preparation step scales only strixel local-v Gaussian sigma by four, conditional on verified native-ID remapping of explicitly identified 0.5 mm reference widths. This extrapolation is not a calibrated 2 mm response; frozen historical reconstruction runners and evidence retain their original guards.

- Strixel channel counts fall by **50%, 66.7% and 75%** at 1, 1.5 and 2 mm. Cable/power estimates are conditional accounting scenarios; no physical service redesign or material reduction is simulated.
- The single-particle GBTS cross-check covers **80 × 1,000 native case-events**, five particle/transport populations and four pT values. At 2 mm, the central 100 GeV muon z0 core is **10.6% wider in Fatras and 15.1% wider in Geant4** than at 0.5 mm on the same common matched events.
- Fatras ttbar + exactly 200 pileup interactions uses **100 shared physical events reconstructed at each length**. After ambiguity resolution and guide-like analysis cuts:

| Strixel length | Hard-scatter efficiency [%] | Pileup efficiency [%] | Fake fraction [%] | Fake fraction, frozen quality only [%] |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0.5 mm | 80.36 | 75.81 | 0.195 | 3.46 |
| 1 mm | 80.40 | 75.86 | 0.181 | 3.65 |
| 1.5 mm | 80.40 | 75.90 | 0.204 | 3.94 |
| 2 mm | 80.36 | 75.91 | 0.230 | 4.24 |

For 2 mm minus 0.5 mm, the guide-selected hard-scatter efficiency change is **0.000 percentage points [−0.211, +0.202]**, and the fake-fraction change is **+0.034 [+0.005, +0.064] percentage points**, with paired pointwise 95% event-bootstrap intervals. Equal aggregate efficiency does not establish equivalence.

![ttbar efficiency and candidate composition](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/ttbar-pu200/figures/guide-overview.png)

Reports: [truth tracking and service estimates](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/results.md), [single-particle GBTS](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/gbts/summary.md), [ttbar + pileup](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/ttbar-pu200/README.md). Reports link the complete figure sets, definitions, uncertainty intervals and independent assessments.

## Included artifacts and reproduction

Includes **78 PNG/PDF exports**, concise reports/provenance, and the generation, reconstruction, audit, statistics and plotting scripts with tests. The recipes document environments, source/configuration/input hashes, seeds and exact commands:

- [Truth-associated pitch/service workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/software/analysis/strixel_pitch_study/README.md)
- [Single-particle GBTS workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/software/analysis/strixel_reconstruction/README.md)
- [Fatras ttbar + pileup workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/software/analysis/strixel_ttbar/README.md)

**No event-level run files, ROOT outputs, NPZ arrays, compressed case datasets or caches are added to the PR.** All 674 excluded study files remain local and ignored, with hashes in the compact artifact inventory. Large unpublished payload commits were removed from the history to be pushed; original local snapshots remain archived for provenance. The published tree retains the pinned native-validator history. Plots and scientific source contents are unchanged by that cleanup.

Task-owned Pythia/Fatras/GBTS components provide the missing runtime binding and numerically safe evaluation needed for the repeatable chain. Numerical corrections preserve selected observables/random draws and are backed by native controls and byte-identical particle/hit/reconstruction replay; they remain isolated from shared dependencies and production geometry.

## Validation and interpretation

The [human selection](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/109#issuecomment-6573426341) and [approval](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/109#pullrequestreview-5734614248) apply to study head `07b38a7`. The subsequent baseline integration has a separate independent PhysVal assessment at `268f7a1` plus CMake amendment `88a77da`: all 27 component export files and materials are byte-identical; combined XML differs only in coarse pitch and offset for the two strixel readouts. No fresh native geometry or reconstruction execution is claimed by this source-level comparison. DES042 remains DRAFT under the engineering lifecycle.

- **8 current assembly/integration tests, 3 selected-response tests and 33 session/documentation-link tests pass.** The CI failure was a link to the intentionally excluded local `profiles.json.gz`; both report and generator now explain regeneration without requiring that payload. Historical DES040 fingerprints remain checked against unchanged evidence, with the three intentionally amended sources read at the pre-selection revision.

- **144 Python tests** and all **78 figure hashes/source bindings** pass. A separate clean checkout containing no DES-042 datasets passes the same tests and project/session/usage/workflow checks.
- All 400 ttbar reconstruction payloads and all 100 Fatras sample payloads match the preserved originals byte-for-byte. Full portable replay and 2,000 paired event-bootstrap calculations pass locally. Independent PhysVal assessment reproduced all 1,864 metrics/intervals and 10,920 representative count checks with no unresolved blocker.
- CI checks synthetic analysis tests and published figure integrity. Full native/event/statistical replay explicitly requires the local retained data or a regenerated campaign; it is not claimed as a data-free CI check.

Qualifications: constant 3 T and fixed geometry/material; the GBTS/ttbar scans use uncalibrated Gaussian local-v response without cluster merging. Boundary retries also change non-target smearing. The unchanged 2,000,000-edge GBTS cap is reached in **99/100 ttbar events**. The ttbar hard process follows the guide's **qqbar-only** setup. Six low-momentum Fatras step-limit losses remain documented; none is headline-eligible. These are qualified prototype results, without physical coarse-cell occupancy calibration, hardware-service qualification or formal detector-design acceptance.

events.text:
**The 2 mm strixel is comparable to the quoted ATLAS SCT longitudinal precision—and about 29% finer than a standalone two-strip binary stereo estimate.**

The SCT barrel uses **80 µm strip pitch** and **40 mrad between the two sensor sides**. [ATLAS module paper](https://cds.cern.ch/record/974073/files/indet-pub-2006-005.pdf)

For two independent binary measurements:

\[
\sigma_{\rm strip}=\frac{80\,\mu{\rm m}}{\sqrt{12}}=23.1\,\mu{\rm m},
\qquad
\sigma_z\simeq\frac{\sqrt{2}\,\sigma_{\rm strip}}{0.040}
=\mathbf{816\,\mu{\rm m}}.
\]

For our 2 mm longitudinal cell:

\[
\sigma_z=\frac{2\,{\rm mm}}{\sqrt{12}}
=\mathbf{577\,\mu{\rm m}}.
\]

There is a convention worth keeping explicit:

| Comparison | Longitudinal resolution |
|---|---:|
| 2 mm strixel, binary estimate | **577 µm** |
| SCT, both independent strip errors propagated | **816 µm** |
| SCT commonly quoted effective precision | **≈580 µm** |

ATLAS quotes approximately 580 µm with fit correlations; mathematically, treating the transverse crossing position as known also gives \(\sigma_{\rm strip}/\sin\alpha\approx577\,\mu\mathrm m\). The explicit **816 µm** two-plane value is also documented for ATLAS SCT spare modules used by FASER. [FASER detector paper, §2.1](https://cds.cern.ch/record/2816452/files/Publication.pdf)

SysArch-01 completed read-only at **`1dff0452ed1e7ac24d7b746fccc02ee15df5258d`**. No files changed.

The implemented hardware model gives **zero space saving from segmentation alone**. It fixes harness, fibre, cooling and tray geometry by module/network counts. The following savings require an explicit redesigned harness hypothesis.

For electronic module load \(P=P_0[(1-f)+f(0.5/p)]\), use \(P_0=7.8\) or \(31.7288135593\) W, longitudinal pitch \(p\) in mm, and channel-dependent power fraction \(f\). Reaggregate power bundles independently within each network:

- Barrel: \(h_B=\lceil(14P+5)/(12P_0)\rceil\).
- Endcap: \(h_E=\lceil(30P+5)/(12P_0)\rceil\).
- Preserve fibres, HV connectivity, cooling and trays.

Both electronic load normalizations produce identical integer bundle counts:

| Assumption | Pitch | Power bundles/network, B / EC | Total power bundles, both ends | Power cable envelope volume saved |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline | 0.5 mm | 2 / 3 | 1,584 | 0 |
| \(f=0\) | All alternatives | 2 / 3 | 1,584 | 0 |
| \(f=0.5\) | 1, 1.5, 2 mm | 1 / 2 | 864 | **242.734 L** |
| \(f=1\) | 1 mm | 1 / 2 | 864 | **242.734 L** |
| \(f=1\) | 1.5, 2 mm | 1 / 1 | 720 | **273.421 L** |

These volumes cover **radial collectors/fans and downstream longitudinal transport**, excluding local buses and module flexes. The baseline is **516.155 L power cable envelope plus 37.254 L fixed fibre envelope**. Savings split into barrel **212.047 L** and endcap **30.687 / 61.375 L**.

With native additive pipe inventory retained—**44 barrel plus 12 endcap trunk pairs per end**—final one-end bare service areas are:

| Bundle state | Bare service area/end | Mean area-equivalent radial width* | Worst-sector equivalent width* |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline 2 / 3 | 128,902.563 mm² | 73.273 mm | 75.590 mm |
| Redesigned 1 / 2 | 78,133.169 mm² | 45.263 mm | 46.717 mm |
| Redesigned 1 / 1 | 67,979.290 mm² | 39.535 mm | 41.000 mm |

\*Exact annular inversion at inner radius 710 mm, 75% usable azimuth and 50% packing; excludes walls, bends and connector allowances. Thus approximate recoverable radial allocation is **28.0–33.7 mm globally**, or **28.9–34.6 mm using the worst sector**. These are area-equivalent comparisons, not a qualified narrower corridor.

Important qualifications:

- The 13.4 mm source benchmark contains **12 independent LV and 12 HV channels**. Combining more modules requires redesigned fanouts, conductors, connectors and HV distribution. Relative load capacity does not establish installed current capacity.
- Fibre traffic should remain fixed for this first estimate: longer cells do not reduce traversing particle flux proportionately.
- The adopted 20% copper power-cable recipe is an effective material fixture, not a conductor specification. A conductor-only scaling proxy gives at most \(103.231\,f(1-0.5/p)\) litres removed, before unknown fixed HV/control copper. With unchanged outer diameters this frees **no external space**.
- Nominal baseline native payload slightly exceeds the average 73 mm corridor packing budget; worst sector fill is **1.0373** before tray walls. Historical capacity screens may round combined cooling banks differently. Do not report an unconditional baseline packing pass.
- Longer strixels can require different analogue power to maintain noise performance; neither normalization is a physical bound.

- `tools/short_strip_barrel/model.py:145–162,165–215`: networks, bundle rounding, electronics/leakage separation, boards, rail losses and cooling screens.
- `tools/short_strip_barrel/export.py:201–219`: routed lengths and gross/material cable volumes.
- `tools/short_strip_endcap/model.py:75–86,121–166`: 30-module petals, three bundles, cumulative services and separate engineering screens.

- `tools/tracker_dd4hep/services.py`: native reconciliation preserves both standalone payloads and retains one tray.
- `docs/design/inputs/DES-010-strip-services.md`, SS-F10–12: source dimensions, independent LV/HV topology and comparator power; CMS TDR §§3.2.3–4, pp34–35, Table 5.1 p91.

STRIXEL-GBTS-PhysVal-01: the proposed **80-case, 80,000 processed case-event matrix is scientifically useful as a frozen effective-response reconstruction sensitivity study**, subject to the gates below. It does not establish a preferred physical strixel length, calibrated sensor performance, or equivalence among transport models.

Reviewed revision: `4ea4af17727020bac2ba8f5e2f6172378711c15a`. All 11 pinned input hashes matched the supplied manifest. This was an independent, read-only explicit-mandate fallback assessment; no native profile loading is claimed. No files changed, no simulations ran, and no further agents were delegated.

1. **High — pairing must be demonstrated at several levels.** Same seeds do not establish identical transport or measurements. Within each fixed species/transport/pT block, require complete event IDs, exact generated/native simulated-particle records, and equality of all retained simulated-hit payloads across pitches. Preserve particle/geometry identities, ordering, counts and missing-hit diagnostics.

   The pinned audit currently retains only a simulated-hit count: `software/source/ActsExamples/TrackerReconstruction/Reconstruction.cpp:185`. Counts alone are insufficient. The subsequently proposed end-of-order `RootSimHitWriter`, paired with exact generated/simulated records, is adequate for this bounded study if described as **persisted float32 hit-payload equality**. Record column types and numerical precision; do not claim native float64 bitwise equality. A new float64 observer is unnecessary absent unexplained discrepancies.

   Pair measurements by physical hit/source identity rather than blindly by measurement index, because discarded measurements can renumber later source links.

2. **High — distinguish frozen response parameters from identical realized pixel inputs.** Native sensitive-boundary retries can consume additional digitization draws; changing strixel-v sigma may change later fine-u, pixel or long-strip realized measurements despite their unchanged configured widths. Zero lost measurements does not prove zero retries. This limitation is explicit in `software/analysis/truth_tracking/smearing.py:13` and the prior control report at `docs/validation/DES-042/results.md:139`.

   Compare across pitches:
   
   - Non-target configured sigmas/covariances, which must remain identical.
   - Pixel measured coordinates, space points and ordered GBTS seed membership.
   - Fine-u/long-strip realized residuals and changed-coordinate counts.
   - Measurement losses, especially versus distance to sensor boundaries.

   If pixel inputs and seeds remain identical, differences downstream can be localized much more tightly.
